sources.title: Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 2 - Hailo-10H with 40 TOPS and Local LLMs
sources.snippet: The AI HAT+ 2 uses the new Hailo-10H chip with 40 TOPS and is the only model with 8 GB of dedicated LPDDR4X RAM. This allows it to run local language models (LLMs like Llama 3.2) directly on the chip for the first time - the predecessors (Hailo-8L with 13 TOPS and Hailo-8 with 26 TOPS) cannot do this.
